name: list_states
description: List all 27 Brazilian states (UFs) with id, 2-letter sigla, name, and region (e.g. "SP" → São Paulo, Sudeste). Useful for resolving state names/codes before querying municipalities or regional data.

name: list_municipalities
description: List municipalities for a given state (UF). Returns each municipality with its 7-digit IBGE id and name. e.g. uf="RJ" lists all municipalities in Rio de Janeiro.

name: lookup_municipality
description: Look up a single municipality by its 7-digit IBGE code, returning full hierarchy (micro/mesoregion, state, region). e.g. code="3550308" → São Paulo (capital).

code.description: 7-digit IBGE municipality code, e.g. "3550308" (São Paulo) or "3304557" (Rio de Janeiro).

name: aggregated_data
description: Pull official IBGE/SIDRA statistical series (inflation, GDP, population, etc.). Specify the aggregate table, variable, periods, and locality. Common examples: IPCA monthly inflation = aggregate "1737" variable "63"; population estimate = aggregate "6579" variable "9324". Returns time series keyed by period.

aggregate.description: SIDRA aggregate (table) id, e.g. "1737" (IPCA) or "6579" (population estimate). Discover ids via list_aggregates.

variable.description: Variable id within the aggregate, e.g. "63" (IPCA monthly variation %). Use "all" for every variable.

periods.description: Periods: "-1" (latest), "-6" (last 6), or explicit like "202604" or "202601-202604". Default "-1".

localities.description: Locality filter, e.g. "N1[all]" (Brazil), "N3[35]" (state SP), "N6[3550308]" (a municipality). Default "N1[all]". Brackets are auto-encoded.

name: list_aggregates
description: Browse the catalog of IBGE/SIDRA aggregate tables grouped by subject (inflation, agriculture, demographics, etc.). Use to discover aggregate ids to pass to aggregated_data. Optionally filter by research/subject acronym.

acronym.description: Optional research acronym to filter by, e.g. "PNAD", "IPCA". Omit to list everything.

name: name_frequency
description: Brazilian census name statistics. Pass a first name to get its registration frequency by decade (since 1930), optionally filtered by sex or state. e.g. name="maria". Pass name="ranking" to get the top names instead.

name.description: First name to look up, e.g. "maria", "joao". Special value "ranking" returns the most popular names.

locality.description: Optional 2-digit state id, e.g. "33" (RJ), "35" (SP). Omit for whole country (BR).

decade.description: Optional decade filter for ranking, e.g. "1990", "2000".
